name: avatar-account-menu
title: Account dropdown menu
description: Account dropdown menu. Core/Avatar pattern composed from @gaudi/design-system/core/Avatar and other public Gaudi components; the components stay package imports.
docs: Copy-in pattern built on @gaudi/design-system; the components stay package imports. Load '@gaudi/design-system/global.css' once and add transpilePackages: ['@gaudi/design-system'] in Next.js. Until the package is on npm, install it from GitHub first: pnpm add github:g-udi/design-system. Demo assets referenced (supply your own or copy them into public/): /avatars/person-23.svg.

files.content: import { AvatarRoot as Avatar, AvatarFallback, AvatarImage } from '@gaudi/design-system/core/Avatar'; import { default as Button } from '@gaudi/design-system/core/Button'; import { DropdownMenuRoot as DropdownMenu, DropdownMenuContent, DropdownMenuGroup, DropdownMenuItemPrimitive as DropdownMenuItem, DropdownMenuLabelPrimitive as DropdownMenuLabel, DropdownMenuSeparatorPrimitive as DropdownMenuSeparator, DropdownMenuTrigger } from '@gaudi/design-system/core/DropdownMenu'; import { RegistryIcon } from '@gaudi/design-system/icons/RegistryIcon'; export function Pattern() { return ( Management Profile Settings Teams Invite Log out ); }
